stem:
Anaya compares two situations before calculating a missing value.
Situation 1: more identical taps fill a tank in less time.
Situation 2: more notebooks at the same price cost more money.

Which two claims correctly classify the relationships?

options.text: Call Situation 1 inverse proportion as a label and Situation 2 the same label.
Situation 1 is inverse proportion, because taps and time move in opposite directions.
Situation 2 is direct proportion, because notebooks and cost increase together.
Inverse proportion is what creates more taps finishing the tank sooner.

teacher.key_rationale: Taps vs time is inverse; notebooks vs cost is direct. One shared inverse label for both, or saying inverse creates the tap story, miss the classify-first hinge.
